title: BJP-SAD reunion: Can the alliance alter Punjab's political landscape?

ai.summary: The BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) revived their alliance ahead of Punjab assembly elections after splitting in 2020 over farm laws, which had cost both parties significant electoral losses.

facts.claim: The alliance between the two parties ended after the SAD withdrew from the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020 in protest against the (now-withdrawn) three farm laws
facts.quote: The alliance between the two parties ended after the SAD withdrew from the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020 in protest against the (now-withdrawn) three farm laws

facts.claim: The two parties had first come together in the 1996 Lok Sabha elections
facts.quote: The two parties had first come together in the 1996 Lok Sabha elections

facts.claim: The BJP-SAD alliance won the highest number of assembly constituencies (AC) or parliamentary constituencies (PC) in six of the 12 elections held between 1996 and 2019
facts.quote: The BJP-SAD alliance won the highest number of assembly constituencies (AC) or parliamentary constituencies (PC) in six of the 12 elections held between 1996 and 2019

facts.claim: The two parties put together won just 4.3% and 7.7% of the ACs and PCs in the 2022 assembly and 2024 Lok Sabha elections
facts.quote: the two parties put together won just 4.3% and 7.7% of the ACs and PCs in the 2022 assembly and 2024 Lok Sabha elections

ai.background_note: The BJP-SAD alliance revival follows their 2020 split over farm laws, which led to significant electoral setbacks for both parties in Punjab.
